description: No module the MCP server can reach writes to the process's stdout except bin/lib/output-sink.ts. The walk follows static and dynamic relative imports from mcp/**; stdout is the server's JSON-RPC channel, and its pensmith_* tools run the CLI verbs in-process (a `pensmith plan: wrote …` line there made Claude Code drop the server, T1-15). It checks each reachable module's text for process.stdout.write, the process.stdout stream handed around as a value or taken out of process under another name (`import { stdout } from 'node:process'`, `const { stdout: s } = process`), every console method call but warn, error, trace and assert (console.log, count, group, timeLog, dirxml … print to stdout; globalThis.console included), and process or console itself taken under another name or passed as a value (`const p = process`, `f(console)`), wherever the module lives — also outside the stdout-sink lint row's scope and allow list (a statically imported pdf-worker.ts would print on the main thread; pdf-text.ts's type-only import of it is erased at runtime and not followed). Print through out(); the server points that sink at stderr.
